verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs include a dedicated guide for creating off-cycle payrolls outside the regular schedule (gusto-docs-32). They say off-cycle payrolls handle corrections and special bonuses using the same withholding, deductions and contributions as regular payroll (gusto-docs-4). A Bonus off_cycle_reason applies fixed-rate withholding with benefits and deductions blocked by default (gusto-docs-47). The platform overview lists off-cycle payments alongside termination processing (gusto-docs-44, gusto-docs-52). missing for 10: explicit documentation that terminations run as an off-cycle payroll (termination processing is only listed alongside it), independent or hands-on corroboration of running off-cycle payrolls.
